members.name: John B. Sawyer
members.title: Founder, Principal & Chief Executive Officer
members.bio:
John B. Sawyer is the Founder, Principal, and Chief Executive Officer of Hemisphere Aerospace Investments, providing executive leadership across HAI and Hemisphere Aerospace Defense. He brings nearly four decades of commercial aerospace experience, including three decades in executive and board-level roles, and has originated, negotiated, and closed more than 250 aircraft transactions. His career spans the full lifecycle of complex aviation assets: acquisition, financing, leasing, heavy maintenance, modification, and return to service.

He launched a Boeing 737-400 passenger-to-freighter conversion program spanning more than 40 aircraft, with recent B737-800 sales and retrofits for SpaceX and RTX Corporation, coordinating engineering, certification, MRO providers, and supplier networks across multiple organizations.

His experience includes large-scale aviation transactions requiring the coordination of aircraft, equipment, spare parts, logistics, maintenance, and complex supplier networks, including a principal role in the 2003 US Airways acquisition of 105 aircraft, one of the largest used-aircraft transactions in history.

At Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, John applies that experience to moving programs from concept and acquisition into operational capability, where disciplined execution, supply-chain coordination, and long-term sustainment determine mission success.

members.name: Craig McPike
members.title: Chair, Board of Strategy & Oversight
members.bio:
Craig McPike, Brigadier General, U.S. Air Force Retired, chairs the Board of Strategy and Oversight for Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, guiding defense strategy, program oversight, and senior engagement with government, allied, and industry partners. He brings more than three decades of Air Force leadership, with assignments in five major commands spanning unit, group, wing, MAJCOM, and Air Staff levels, including command of organizations exceeding 12,000 personnel.

As Deputy Commander of the Air Force Recruiting Service, he helped lead 3,700 Total Force Airmen and civilians across approximately 1,275 recruiting offices in the U.S. and abroad, an enterprise responsible for all enlisted accessions, bringing more than 45,000 individuals annually into the Air Force, Air Force Reserve, Air National Guard, and Space Force, and managing all strategic marketing for the U.S. Air Force.

He also served as Reserve Director for U.S. Southern Command, where he oversaw joint and combined full-spectrum military operations and supported efforts to enhance regional security and cooperation across Central and South America and the Caribbean Basin. A graduate of Texas A&M University commissioned through ROTC, he is a command pilot with more than 3,700 flying hours in tactical, combat, educational, and test flight operations, and has flown combat and combat-support missions in operations Southern Watch, Allied Force, and Freedom's Sentinel.

At Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, he applies that operational and command experience to advancing autonomous maritime and unmanned defense systems.

members.name: Brendan McPherson
members.title: Board Member and Senior Strategic Advisor
members.bio:
Brendan McPherson serves as a Member of the Board and Senior Strategic Advisor for Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, supporting defense strategy, program oversight, and senior engagement with government, allied, and industry partners. A retired United States Coast Guard Rear Admiral, he brings nearly four decades of maritime security and homeland defense leadership. Rear Admiral McPherson served nearly 12 cumulative years at sea aboard six cutters, including command of three.

As a two-star Flag Officer, he served as Military Advisor to the Secretary of Homeland Security, Commander of the Coast Guard Seventh District, Deputy Commander of Coast Guard Pacific Area, and Director of Operations (J3) at U.S. Southern Command. He graduated from the United States Coast Guard Academy in 1989 with a Bachelor of Science in Management, and holds a Master of Arts in Public Relations from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and a Master of Arts in National Security and Strategic Studies from the United States Naval War College. That operational background now informs his advisory work on the company's autonomous and unmanned maritime programs.

members.name: Alex Hart
members.title: Chief Financial Officer
members.bio:
Alex Hart serves as Chief Financial Officer for Hemisphere Aerospace Investments and Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, bringing experience across financial operations, accounting, government contracting, and regulatory compliance. Within the defense sector, he helped scale a finance and accounting organization from approximately 30 to more than 200 employees.

He directed cash disbursement operations responsible for approximately $1.5 billion in subcontractor payments and supported financial strategy associated with roughly $2.5 billion in government contract funding. His prior experience includes managing financial operations tied to more than $400 million in real estate assets across a nationwide portfolio. A graduate of Texas A&M University with a Bachelor of Science in Accounting, he brings a disciplined approach to financial strategy, compliance, and operational planning.

members.name: Robert Riedell
members.title: Director of Programs
members.bio:
Robert Riedell serves as Director of Programs for Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, bringing more than 30 years of aerospace and defense leadership experience spanning military aviation, aircraft modernization, engineering, sustainment, certification, flight test, and complex program execution. Prior to HAD, Robert served as General Manager of Level 5 Aerospace, where he led the establishment and FAA Part 145 certification of a new MRO operation.

He previously spent nearly a decade with L3Harris Integrated Aerospace Systems in senior engineering and program leadership roles supporting major military and commercial aircraft programs. Earlier, Robert completed a 20-year career in the United States Air Force, including assignments as Deputy Group Commander and Squadron Commander. He holds a master's degree from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from North Carolina State University, and is a certified Project Management Professional (PMP).

members.name: Chip Fichtner
members.title: Head of Engineering
members.bio:
Chip Fichtner serves as Head of Engineering for Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, leading system and platform engineering, technical design, engineering standards, and program execution across development efforts. He brings more than 40 years as an engineering and operations executive, including service as an Executive Director at RTX, where he led large engineering, manufacturing, quality, and program-management organizations.

His career spans P&L responsibility from $5 million to $900 million and teams of more than 500 across domestic and international operations, with expertise in advanced manufacturing, Lean operations, and complex systems integration. He is recognized for recovering underperforming programs and building disciplined organizations that deliver complex work reliably, experience he now applies to Hemisphere Aerospace Defense's engineering and program development.

members.name: Dalton Sawyer
members.title: Technical Director
members.bio:
Dalton Sawyer serves as Technical Director for Hemisphere Aerospace Investments and Hemisphere Aerospace Defense, providing technical leadership across commercial and defense programs. He works closely with engineering teams, program leadership, and strategic partners to ensure technical requirements, systems integration, and engineering efforts remain aligned with mission objectives and program goals.

Dalton's responsibilities include technical planning, engineering coordination, systems integration, and the development of technical standards that support complex aerospace initiatives. He helps translate program requirements into practical engineering solutions while coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently, reliably, and in alignment with the strategic objectives of HAI and HAD.

members.name: Austin Fichtner
members.title: Technology Strategy & Integration
members.bio:
Austin Fichtner supports technology strategy, systems integration, and industrialization across Hemisphere Aerospace Defense programs, helping translate emerging technologies and complex engineering concepts into scalable, operational capabilities. His work spans advanced manufacturing, autonomy and sensing technologies, digital systems, and the production strategies that move programs from early development toward deployment.

He previously served as Innovation Director at Cresting Wave and founded ElectriFit, an IoT and AI-enabled technology company that was successfully developed through acquisition. At HAD, he focuses on integration planning, manufacturing readiness, verification strategy, and the transition of advanced technologies into deployable systems. He holds a B.B.A. in Entrepreneurship from Baylor University.
